title: Synthetic Data Vault (SDV) Examples and Experiments GitHub Repository
summary: A student study repository evaluating the utility and dependability of synthetic tabular data generated from UCI datasets like Adult and Hepatitis. It directly imports SDV's single-table API, fitting a CTGANSynthesizer on real data, building a SingleTableMetadata schema, and calling evaluate_quality to assess the synthetic output, making SDV's CTGAN synthesizer and quality-report evaluation the core tool being run.
